description.value: Cheese Slap is a Halal fusion restaurant on Vancouver's Granville Strip blending North American comfort food with South Asian flavors through dishes like Tandoori Chicken Cheesesteak, Butter Chicken Pizza, and Double Slap Smash Burgers. Set in a modern, renovated space at the heart of the downtown entertainment district, it caters to both lunchtime and late-night crowds. Free pickup ordering via the ZOMI platform makes it a practical and flavorful stop for cyclists passing through downtown Vancouver.
